source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            crop = [[grid[y][x] for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
            objects.append((color, crop))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    return [[v for _, crop in objects for v in crop[r]] for r in range(len(objects[0][1]))]
'''
